author: reek
body: Tab must mean one thing in a unit that carries both chapters, which is what every guios application already carries: `FilterableList` reaches `UI Focus`, and `TextField`, `DataTable`, `Dropdown`, `TreeView` and `CommandPalette` each reach `UI KeyInput`.

author: reek
body: This chapter defines `key-tab` itself, so what it sees is decided by the order the build globs files, which is the condition CDX3006 describes. It asks two chapters for the same key and requires them to agree: `key-tab` as read from here, against `scancode-to-keycode 15`, which is KeyInput's own answer for the Tab position and resolves inside KeyInput whatever this chapter sees.

author: reek
body: The enter rows are the control. `key-enter` has only ever had one definition, so they read AGREE in both worlds; if they ever move, the instrument is wrong rather than the subject.
